intuition: Represent each memory cell by its owner so first-fit allocation and freeing by owner are straightforward.

brute_force.approach: For each allocation, scan for the first free contiguous block; freeing also scans the full array.

optimal.approach: Scan once for the first free run, fill it with the requested ID, and scan once to free matching cells.

edge_cases: An allocation larger than every free run returns -1.
Freeing an ID that owns no cells returns zero.
